summary: FruitMatch Android oyunu projesi. Google AdMob doğrulama sorunu için app-ads.txt endpoint'i uygulamaya ekleniyor.
architectural_notes: app-ads.txt must be served at https://fruitverse-kaz.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt with AdMob publisher ID pub-7936595519986908
known_issues: Google AdMob cannot verify FruitMatch (Android) app due to missing/invalid app-ads.txt file

existing_features.title: Serve a plain-text `app-ads.txt` file at the root URL path `/app-ads.txt` of the application (i.e., accessible at `https://fruitverse-kaz.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt`). The file must contain exactly the following line: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0`

new_feature_requests.summary: Add app-ads.txt endpoint at the app's root URL for Google AdMob verification
